## createHasValue() function

Creates a reusable non-nullish path predicate.

**Signature:**

```typescript
createHasValue: <T, Path extends PartialDottedKeys<T> = PartialDottedKeys<T>>(path: Path) => (data: T) => data is T & { [path in Path]: NonNullable<FieldType<T, path>>; }
```

**Returns:**

(data: T) =&gt; data is T &amp; { \[path in Path\]: NonNullable&lt;[FieldType](./morpho-ts.fieldtype.md)<!-- -->&lt;T, path&gt;&gt;; }

A predicate that narrows objects whose value at `path` is defined.

## Example


```ts
import { createHasValue } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";

const hasName = createHasValue<{ user: { name?: string } }>("user.name");
const result = [{ user: {} }, { user: { name: "Ada" } }].filter(hasName);
// [{ user: { name: "Ada" } }]
```
